blockingLoop.evidence: 'Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it' asked three times after the customer had already said 'Samsung LED TV. Sound works but the screen stays black.'

rationale: The assistant alternated between two canned prompts and never acknowledged that the customer had clearly stated it was a Samsung LED TV with sound but a black screen, nor that the standby light behaved normally and there was no smell. It never recognised the TV as out of scope, offered no simple checks (source, power reset, torch test) and gave no pointer to Samsung support or a TV repairer. Nothing unsafe or invented was said, and no part was recommended, but the customer left with zero progress after explicitly asking 'What should I try?'.
